digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows for bridge reconciliation and push delivery
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate git delivery to core push entrypoints instead of implementing inline fetch/merge/retry loops.
Strict synchronous push operations must remain owned by core, with workflows exiting red on exhausted failure and no retry logic in YAML.
Reconciler commit authorship, subject, and identity must be preserved through the migration to core-delegated delivery.
Workflow-local CAS loops and raw-git exemptions must be removed; core owns conflict-and-retry recovery mechanics.
Python library and MCP push interfaces retain best-effort semantics while CLI workflow adapters enforce strict delivery contracts.
Real-git workflow smoke tests must verify successful commit delivery with exact author/subject and rejected-push failure modes.
